cases.before: On pinned Friday source, the two corrected native path-alias custody regressions both returned no holder for an equivalently named owned file (0/2 PASS).
cases.after: On the same source plus the scoped normalization fix, both alias regressions passed (2/2); the combined native controls passed 12/12 and TypeScript typecheck passed. External PR #23 was merged by the original maintainer.
cases.comparability: The Index S2 file-custody hypothesis was committed before fresh Friday source inspection (OpenSiro 0fbad73f); matched corrected test fixture and pinned Friday main@079c5af5 were independently executed on dev-alpha-2. An earlier incomplete test fixture was reported and corrected before the matched RED/GREEN comparison. Merge/readback is a later external GitHub observation, not the same test run. No deployment or user workload was measured.
cases.next_gate: Native S2 coordination correctness and original maintainer merger are source-backed; monitor delivery and actual user impact separately. Do not infer a deployed product benefit, new VSM grade or independent S1 autonomy.

cases.before: Pinned native edit_file lost one distinct same-file edit in 50/50 trials; shared-registry delegate_task replay lost 29/30.
cases.after: Local per-file guarded edit_file preserved both in 50/50 native trials and 30/30 delegated-registry replays; disjoint-file control 50/50.
cases.comparability: Same Kram commit, native Go tool and fixed concurrent source workloads. Delegated calls use a synthetic task selector, not a model; 50-trial and 30-trial results are local observations. Independent blind selection is potentially contaminated by prior session context.
cases.next_gate: Native scripted technical gate satisfied for scoped edit_file correctness; remaining steps are first-party code/fit review, exact-stage authority and human-owned external contribution. No S2 regrade.

cases.comparability: Same pinned Zot source and deterministic synthetic runners, but explicit retry changes the schedule and throughput.
